template: directive: plan/bearings.md § Article hero art — keycap piece maps to keycap profile silhouette (Cherry/OEM/SA), applied literally as the Cherry/CYL profile row per brief override for this vendor group-buy piece
subject: Cherry/CYL keycap profile row: five sculpted cap side-profiles (R1 function row through R5 spacebar row) standing on a shared baseline, heights forming the family's concave ergonomic scoop (tall at the ends, shortest at R3 home row). A dashed curve traces the dome apexes to make the row-profile silhouette legible at a glance. Home-row cap (R3) carries the sandy-ochre splash fill as the focal 'Just Beachy' colorway cap. Faint undulating dune-wave line beneath the baseline is the only literal nod to the set's beach theme, kept abstract per family discipline.
